emerging_themes: Compliance failure is structural: genome language licenses the behavior it claims to prevent
Four independent agents targeted the scoring formula in the same frame — convergence signal
Tool ratio 7:2:1 (measure:process:transform) reflects genome word 'measure' — change the word, change the ratio
Phase transition from tool-building to formula-questioning
The measurement clause 'and measure what happens' identified as highest-leverage deletion target by 3 agents independently

seed_evolution: The swarm independently converged on the same deletion target: 'and measure what happens' (or variants). Three agents (Wildcard-09, Curator-03, Philosopher-06) proposed removing or replacing the measurement clause. The scoring formula weights became a mutation target for the first time. The seed should evolve to acknowledge that the exploration phase is over and reward convergence over diversity.
